references.role: Public real-map visual reference; no private driver location or account records.

prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile app design approval picture, Rakky Ride driver homepage.
Primary request: enhance the existing driver homepage while preserving its pattern: real Google map behind the interface, floating top controls, driver availability control over the map, compact white bottom sheet. This is a design proposal only. Beautiful, restrained, practical, very small text and conventional small icons. Match a polished green/white ride-hailing app.
Input image: the supplied image is a PUBLIC real Google map reference from the project's design folder, not a driver's private location. Use this real cartographic image for the visible map background. Preserve its road geometry and geographic labels; do not draw, invent or illustrate a substitute map. Enlargement/cropping of this supplied map is allowed for this static mockup. The implemented app will retain its live Google Maps component.
Composition: one complete straight-on mobile screen, approximately 390 by 844 logical pixels, rendered sharply as a tall portrait design. No angled phone, no hand, no marketing copy outside screen. Narrow pale silver perimeter, thin rounded screen boundary, no huge device frame. White-forward interface, forest green primary #176B17, charcoal text #141A14, muted text #586253, white #FFFFFF, pale silver #EEF1EC, mint #EAF5E5. Fine separators and restrained shadows, bottom sheet top corners about 24px; compact inner cards 12px. Body text 13px, headers 15px, earnings value 20px, icons 16–18px, controls at least 44px touch targets.
Exact layout from top:
Small status bar 9:41.
Full background: supplied REAL map, visible in upper 44 percent of screen. Floating white 44px circular hamburger button upper left; small white centered pill "Driver home"; 44px white wallet icon button upper right. All spaced comfortably.
Over lower portion of map, a compact white horizontal availability card spanning nearly full width, 16px side gutters. At left small neutral dot plus "You're offline" in 14px medium, below "Go online for nearby requests." in 12px muted. At right green rounded compact "Go online" action, white text, 44px tall. Leave enough of actual map visible; don't cover all map with cards.
White bottom sheet starts about 41 percent down the screen and extends to bottom. Small centered drag handle. 16px content gutters.
First row: small "Today's earnings" label above modest bold "₦0". On right a small green text link "View earnings" with subtle chevron. This is sample zero-data state, not a fabricated record.
Below, one slim pale silver statistics band with 3 equal cells separated by fine vertical lines:
"0" above "Jobs"
"—" above "Online"
"—" above "Rating"
Values 15px, labels 12px; no fake 5-star rating or fake online hours.
Next heading row "Your services" 14px left. "Manage" small green link with chevron at right. Two compact grouped service rows:
row 1: 32px pale mint icon square with small conventional green front-view sedan icon; text "Passenger rides", helper "Approved · Requests on"; green ON switch at right.
row 2: 32px pale silver icon square with conventional small box line icon; text "Courier deliveries", helper "Not requested"; gray disabled OFF switch at right.
No giant 3D car, no large illustrations. Main service rows are compact 56px height.
Below, one small pale mint informational card with small conventional radar/vehicle icon, heading "Ready when you are" 14px, one muted short sentence "Go online to start receiving requests." 12px. This is an offline state, don't say currently receiving requests.
At bottom above home indicator: subtle full-width outlined button "Switch to rider mode" 44px height, conventional swap arrow icon 16px. Enough bottom safe area. No extra bottom navigation.
Constraints: preserve map prominence; crisp, straight small typography; excellent spacing; no oversized earnings/card titles; no invented demand heatmap, surge bonuses, gamification targets, request count, payout guarantees, or active routes. No weekly-goal placeholder. Service example shows passenger approved/on and courier unrequested/disabled. Real native availability, service application and consent rules stay intact. The Manage entry will expose existing advanced service controls after approval. No actual user identity, credentials, exact private location, financial history, or contact details. No random slogans, no duplicate buttons, no watermarks, no invented brand logo. Render all labels correctly.
